failure_summary: Initial ten tests exposed absent image suffix controls and missing namespace head metadata (two failures/seven errors).

First integration passed image continuation/replay but malformed image parts returned 409 rather than validation 400. Adapter now maps malformed renderer input to UnsupportedTextRequest before encoder work; assertions unchanged.

CLI red attempt retained missing image/parts flags. Intermediate green had six setup errors because the new fixture referenced CowCLIImagesTests instead of existing CowCliImagesTests; corrected only the fixture name. Final seventeen tests pass, including disconnect during encoding.
limitations: Q4/GPU0/Linux CUDA, compatible mixed roots and greedy only. Adding the first image to a legacy token-only root, changed image sampling/grammar/seed/stop controls, Q8 and split GPUs remain unsupported/unqualified.

Four full vectors reuse independent retained root/first-question references for identical inputs. Four later-turn/cold vectors come from two newly initialized uncached native references with independent CPU positions; not every generated frontier.
All six generated controllers match the canonical greedy start/consume equations. Each request naturally stops after two consumed outputs versus a limit of eight.

Both Python HTTP servers exit zero; their native processes are verified absent, but individual native exit codes are not retained by this server-level harness. Three real encoders and two new raw references exit zero and absent.
Three managed embeddings and six client input files are deleted. Raw independent reference inputs remain outside the managed cache; no claim all copies globally vanished.

A separate pending client journal copies two exact actual submitted bodies to simulate a missed local acknowledgment. Actual CLI replay runs after server restart at the original URL. No network-drop/crash/power-loss injection is claimed.
New text followups load 151284240 native bytes each and evaluate 30 new text inputs plus two outputs. No throughput, peak memory, 8K/long-context or full pressure qualification.
Synthetic CPU replay mutant deliberately produces one expected error; it is not a normal test failure or registered G5 mutation qualification.
Public all-checkpoint-evicted mixed serving reconstruction remains unfinished. VC07-VC09 and original G1-G5 remain open; general images/chat OFF; private Git only.
